requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate NGB keyed ink bottles capable of 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. CMY bottle size must be greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: High-yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement and operational cost, meeting market demand for efficiency and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system compatibility, bottle design, IDS, and tank size changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield with new keyed bottles; CMY bottle size >8K verified in test prints.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottle design provides spill-free reliability during installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for user safety, product quality, and environmental compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank interface design, IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spill incidents in 99% of test installations and replacements.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label; maintain existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and security of ink delivery and prevents tampering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes security, reliability, and compatibility tests with existing mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment ink without reformulation for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D costs, expedites time to market, and maintains proven quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new system, IDS, and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink function reliably in Magellan system without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Ink System Reliability and Modelling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS performance, including startup and NOA-F EOL.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system robustness, print quality, and long-term reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reliability and IDS models validated, system meets defined performance thresholds.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Perform ink stability modelling for the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink degradation, ensures consistent print quality, and reduces service incidents.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model created; no significant PQ degradation observed in accelerated aging tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Part in Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part for in-warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and customer satisfaction by enabling quick replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F listed as a service part and available for warranty claims.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (security/traceability feature) on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product traceability and anti-counterfeiting measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All bottle lids include Acumen 6 and pass traceability validation.

requirements.Title: Modify Existing Factory Line for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Update SA14 line to support NOA-F and add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Factory readiness for new components is essential for production ramp-up.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified and validated for new components production.

requirements.Title: New Keyed Caps Molding
requirements.Description: Create molds for 1 to 4 new keyed bottle caps to support new bottle design.
requirements.Rationale: Supports anti-misuse and product differentiation in the market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds produced and first article inspection passed for all new cap designs.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system for customer-replaceable PHA and NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience, reduces downtime, and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F module design, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F without technical assistance; validated in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses market need for durable, high-volume printing, and competitive warranty offering.
requirements.Dependencies: Component reliability, service parts, QA testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes 80,000 page life tests without critical failure.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Develop SKU 2 with high throughput and PDL (Page Description Language) support for PaaS (Print as a Service) model.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach with flexible business models and high-performance features.
requirements.Dependencies: PDL integration, SKU definition, platform readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available with PDL and PaaS features, validated in market pilots.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with increased tank size; no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield and aligns with new bottle sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank design, platform integration, ADF compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased, system passes yield and fitment tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Implement EPS foam packaging for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Improves shipping robustness and reduces transit damage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: Compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (for PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and safety standards for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for regulatory compliance and market access in specific regions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel (PDL SKU).

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Modifications
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and user convenience with new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function without interference and pass usability tests with new tank.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and accessibility for advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display operational and passes UI usability tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration into the platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports efficient ink delivery and system reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System operates reliably with 4 tubes and new routing; passes flow and stress tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management with spit platform changes due to the tank.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service issues and maintains print quality in high-yield systems.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station and tank design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels within safe limits in service station tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print accuracy with new system configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Carriage and tube design, platform integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes force and dynamic tests with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paper path to support increased page life up to 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new warranty and reliability goals, reduces maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path operates reliably for 80,000 pages in durability tests.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part to be replaced post-80K page life at service centers.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates long-term support and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable at service centers and documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and FI (fluidic interface) connection for IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable ink delivery and system performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connections pass reliability and leak tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size and Keying
requirements.Description: Utilize LEBI ink-tank with increased size, new keying, and LOI (line of interface) One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yields and prevents cross-use of incorrect bottles.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and keying design, SHAID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink-tank system passes fitment and anti-misuse tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management for improved reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces startup failures and air entrapment issues in the ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate >99% in system validation tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm for improved maintenance and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service events and ensures consistent startup performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Servicing and startup algorithms validated in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to meet page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer expectations for output quality and transparency in yield claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion metrics documented and met in testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and accelerates time to market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Existing components function reliably in Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for modern connectivity and remote printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and throughput tests.

requirements.Title: Firmware: Dune
requirements.Description: Utilize Dune firmware for system operation.
requirements.Rationale: Standardizes firmware across platform and leverages proven codebase.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware operational and passes system validation tests.

requirements.Title: Security: Gauss4.xx
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx security for hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Meets security requirements for enterprise and SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features validated and pass penetration testing.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome, and Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses diverse customer segments and increases market coverage.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution and service integration, SKU differentiation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business models supported and validated in market pilots.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Provide integrated scan solution for all supported business models.
requirements.Rationale: Meets functional requirements for SMB and Enterprise customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, SMB/Enterprise Customers
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan solution operational and passes functional tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Support SMB manageability and enterprise features, including WJA, HPSM, JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for IT management in business environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Manageability features validated with WJA, HPSM, JAM.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Compatibility
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible deployment and broad OS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers and clients pass installation and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence (Constrain)
requirements.Description: Project schedule is least flexible and must be adhered to as a business constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for time-to-market and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones met as per defined schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constrain)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a minimum lifetime of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and reduces service costs within warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65,000-page life tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Printer must support a warranty life of 2 years for all critical components.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations and reduces customer risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All critical components pass 2-year accelerated life tests.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 PPM (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 20 ppm for PDL.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive throughput performance required for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25/20 ppm in standard and PDL tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box (Optimize)
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box for improved serviceability and ease of replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user/service replaceable and documented.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Support host 12K-CMYK configuration as a flexible, lower-priority feature.
requirements.Rationale: Provides additional configuration for niche markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Host 12K-CMYK configuration available and validated.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Enable trade page configuration for 6K page yield as a flexible, lower-priority feature.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses specific trade or promotional requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trade page 6K configuration available and validated.
